# causalverse

> An R package by Mike Nguyen that collects the causal inference workflow in one place: randomized experiments, difference-in-differences, synthetic difference-in-differences, synthetic controls, regression discontinuity, instrumental variables, event studies, matching, sensitivity analysis, heterogeneous treatment effects, mediation, and panel data methods, with publication-ready reporting. The documentation site is at https://mikenguyen13.github.io/causalverse/.

- Author: Mike Nguyen, https://mikenguyen.netlify.app
- Repository: https://github.com/mikenguyen13/causalverse
- License: GPL-3

## Research Methods Library (MCP server)

- [MCP endpoint](https://research-methods-mcp.vercel.app/mcp): Model Context Protocol server (streamable HTTP, no authentication) that indexes this package's documentation together with the author's books and research articles. Its tools recommend study designs with their identifying assumptions (`choose_method`), search and read sections (`search`, `fetch`), return runnable R and Python code (`get_code`), and format citations (`cite`); every result links to the section consulted.
- [Research Methods Library](https://research-methods-mcp.vercel.app/): setup instructions for Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, Visual Studio Code, and other MCP clients.

## Overview

- [Home](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/causalverse/): installation, quick examples, and use of the package in AI assistants
- [Function reference](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/causalverse/reference/index.html): every exported function, grouped by design
- [Introduction to CausalVerse](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/causalverse/articles/a_introduction.html)
